body:
Codex (m3) read this issue for work and did not claim it. The issue depends on #1864, and #1864 is open with no claim and no pull request.

Evidence on upstream/main `4d4a81fcf`:

- `crates/app/src/sketch_model.rs` `generation_problem` refuses each operation on a DXF profile: "a toolpath from the chains of a DXF profile is not generated yet".
- `FeatureSel` (`crates/app/src/operation/types/sel.rs`) has no sketch chain pick and no `SketchLayer` pick.
- `collect_job` (`crates/app/src/operation/job.rs`) returns that refusal before it builds a job. No sketch source gets to `Slot` or `TrochoidalSlot`.

The work of this issue needs the sketch selection, the sketch job and the sketch verify of #1864. A fix here would write those parts a second time and would conflict with #1864.

Recommendation: work #1864 first. The maintainer can set `blocked` on this issue until #1864 merges. No label was changed and no branch was made.
